top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Infant Feeding Instructions (26 TAC §747.801(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant in care that is not on table food did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home (26 TAC §747.1801)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A total of one caregiver and ten children were observed inside the licensed childcare home. The maximum children allowed is seven children based on their age group. The licensed childcare home is out of ratio by three children.

top_violation_types.title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found to be deficient. A caregiver admitted to placing the blanket on the child's head and can be seen doing so in a video.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Playground check sheets were not available.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
